# Watching class loads

minapp has a plugin: the Load Plugin button loads `libdynamic.so` and
triggers `Class.forName("re.frida.minapp.dynamic.DynamicTrigger")`. The
classes it creates only exist *after* the press. The class load monitor
finds them.

## 1. Start the monitor

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://attach/usb//FridaMin
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":3718,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}

[0x00000000]> FrNj start
{"ok":true,"result":{"enabled":true}}
```

## 2. Drain (empty at first)

```text
[0x00000000]> FrNj
{"ok":true,"result":{"classes":[],"count":0,"monitor":true}}
```

Nothing loaded since the monitor started.

## 3. Load the plugin

Press Load Plugin in the app (the button reports `Plugin loaded:
dynamic-lib-v1`. Pressing it again reports `Plugin already loaded`), then
drain again:

```text
[0x00000000]> FrNj
{"ok":true,"result":{"classes":["android.animation.AnimatorSet$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0","re.frida.minapp.dynamic.DynamicClass","re.frida.minapp.dynamic.DynamicTrigger"],"count":3,"monitor":true}}
```

The two dynamic classes appeared: plus a framework lambda that happened to
load at the same time. Drain again and the buffer is empty:

```text
[0x00000000]> FrNj
{"ok":true,"result":{"classes":[],"count":0,"monitor":true}}
```

![Class monitor](img/android_journey/class-monitor.png)

## 4. Stop

```text
[0x00000000]> FrNj stop
{"ok":true,"result":{"enabled":false}}
```

Wrong arguments are rejected:

```text
[0x00000000]> FrNj bogus
{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"invalid_target","message":"FrNj expects start, stop, or no arguments to list"}}
```

## Under the hood

The monitor is a **polling snapshot diff**: `start` records every loaded
class as "seen" (if the monitor is already enabled, `start` does not
re-snapshot), and each drain asks ART for the current class list and
reports the names that were not seen before. `stop` sets the monitor flag
false and does **not** clear the seen set, so a later `FrNj` can still
list new names with `monitor: false`. It is not a classloader hook: no new
classloader is intercepted, and classes loaded and unloaded between two
drains are never seen.

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant R as rizin
    participant A as agent
    participant ART as ART
    R->>A: FrNj start
    A->>ART: enumerateLoadedClassesSync
    A-->>R: enabled
    R->>A: FrNj
    A->>ART: enumerateLoadedClassesSync
    A-->>R: new names since last snapshot
```

> **Note:** the app avoids *static* references to the dynamic
> classes: the plugin id is fetched through reflection, so ART cannot
> preload the classes at startup and the monitor sees them load.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Start the monitor, press Load Plugin, watch `DynamicClass` and
`DynamicTrigger` appear, drain until empty, stop. Restart the app and
repeat with a fresh attach.
:::
